name: Major Schwartzkoff
summary: A major identified by Larry at the center of VN-0006, working with two other men to mount a rocket launcher atop Núi Bà Đen (Larry's date guess: June 1965), alongside an Australian captain and — Larry thinks — a Captain Kennedy from Boston.
researchNotes: The spelling is phonetic. Identification work and candidate hypotheses are kept in research/people/major-schwartzkoff.md and are not summarized here while unconfirmed.
